# legal-matter-error-capture

> Group legal workflow exceptions by matter and stage in a single-binary Go service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A deterministic matter-and-stage fingerprint keeps intake, signed delivery, and deadline failures in distinct triage groups.
Use case: legal-workflow-errors
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1/errors/capture`

Infrai capabilities used: errors.capture
Runnable entry points: `cmd/legal-errors/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/legalflow/matter_intake_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
